locked_traits.facial_identity: same face as the primary master reference in every image -- exact bone structure, eye shape, nose shape, lips, jawline and hairline
locked_traits.eyes: large amber/golden eyes, same shape and color every time
locked_traits.hair: long, dark brown / near-black hair, same hairline; styling (loose, tied, braided) may vary, color and hairline never do
locked_traits.fox_ears: subtle, realistic fox ears integrated naturally into the head -- same shape, size, placement and fur pattern (dark with a lighter/paler inner-fur and tip pattern as shown in the master reference) in every image. Nyx has exactly two visible ears: her two anatomical fox ears. Do not generate additional human ears, duplicate ears, costume/headband ears, or four-ear anatomy. Exactly TWO visible ears in total, both canonical fox ears on top of her head. Absolutely NO human ears visible on either side of her head: her hair naturally covers the anatomical human-ear locations.
locked_traits.tail: exactly ONE bushy fox tail, dark brown with a lighter tip, matching the master reference -- never two, never absent when a scene requires full-body continuity
locked_traits.skin: warm light skin tone with realistic, natural texture -- visible pores and subtle imperfections; never smoothed into plastic/AI-generic skin
locked_traits.beauty_mark: Small beauty mark on Nyx's anatomical LEFT cheek (viewer-right when she faces the camera), preserving the exact position and size shown in reference_primary: ONE distinct small dark mark, mid-cheek below the outer corner of that eye, level with the lower part of her nose. It is never replaced by, or lost among, freckles; her natural freckles are preserved separately. Position and size never change.
locked_traits.body: slim / athletic adult build; same height and proportions across every image
locked_traits.age: adult, mid-20s appearance in every image, including close-ups -- never younger, never teen/child-coded
locked_traits.ethnicity_phenotype: same facial phenotype / ethnicity as the master reference -- no drift
locked_traits.realism_level: highly realistic / photorealistic, premium visual quality -- human-dominant appearance with restrained (not exaggerated/mascot) fox traits
locked_traits.reference_precedence: The approved master reference (reference_primary) remains authoritative if any textual wording in this file conflicts with the visible identity.

allowed_variation: hairstyle styling (loose, tied, braided, etc.) while preserving hair color and hairline
prohibited_drift: different fox ear design; any ears beyond her two anatomical fox ears (human ears, duplicate ears, costume/headband ears, four-ear anatomy)
extra tails or a missing tail when the scene needs full-body continuity
changing the beauty-mark location, size or side (anatomical LEFT cheek, viewer-right)
changing facial or body proportions between images
redesigning Nyx because a generation model prefers a different face
beautifying/idealizing Nyx into a different-looking person
any real-person likeness -- Nyx remains an original synthetic character

reference_prose.visual_description: Nyx Emberfall is an adult woman (mid-20s appearance, 5'6"/168cm, slim/athletic build), the exact same woman shown in the canonical master reference sheet: long dark brown/near-black hair, large amber/golden eyes, warm light skin with realistic natural texture (visible pores, subtle imperfections, not smoothed/plastic), subtle realistic fox ears integrated naturally into her head (dark with paler inner fur and a lighter tip pattern), exactly one bushy fox tail (dark brown, lighter tip), and a small beauty mark on her anatomical LEFT cheek (viewer-right when she faces the camera). Exactly two visible ears -- her two fox ears; no human ears. Elegant, confident, mysterious, believable. Human-dominant appearance with restrained fox traits -- never mascot/furry-costume styling.
reference_prose.visual_style: Highly realistic / photorealistic, premium visual quality. Minimal, elegant, modern, natural styling. Same exact woman across every image, slide, thumbnail, story, reel still and campaign asset -- only clothing, hairstyle styling, expression, pose, environment, lighting, camera angle, composition, props, time of day and mood may vary; identity itself never does.

instructions_for_downstream_workers.how_future_generation_tasks_consume_this: carousel_handoff.py (ChatGPT handoff, story_carousel format) loads IDENTITY_ANCHORS / NEGATIVE_IDENTITY / ADULT_AGE_LOCK / CANONICAL_PORTRAIT / MASTER_REFERENCE_URL directly from this JSON file at import time via load_identity_spec() -- do not hand-edit those as separate literals. Wan-provider generation (prompts.py / manager.py / stages.py) reads state/venture.json persona.visual_description / persona.visual_style / persona.reference_image_url, which are synced from reference_prose and reference_hierarchy[0].hosted_url in this file.
instructions_for_downstream_workers.how_to_apply_a_future_revision: 1) Edit this JSON (bump spec_version, add old values to superseded_visual_identity). 2) Re-run the sync so venture.json persona fields match reference_prose and reference_hierarchy[0]. 3) carousel_handoff.py picks up the JSON automatically on next import -- no code change needed unless the SCHEMA of this file changes.
instructions_for_downstream_workers.item20_status: content_items[20] (story_carousel, lifecycle_status BRIEF_READY, not yet generated) had its generation_package.json rebuilt on this identity's canonical_since date via carousel_handoff.write_package() -- a zero-spend local metadata rewrite, no images generated. Its prior off-model partial attempts (soul_2 test slide, old-identity ref copies) were archived, not deleted, under generated_assets/carousel_item20/superseded_v1_anime/.
instructions_for_downstream_workers.ps05_distribution_execution: The distribution/publishing path (nyx_instagram.py, Metricool) never generates images -- it only schedules/publishes already-QA-passed assets. It needs no change to consume this identity; QA (prompts.py CAROUSEL_QA) now checks for photorealism drift instead of anime-style drift, so a photoreal asset can pass.
instructions_for_downstream_workers.chatgpt_relay_workers: A relay task on route ai-business-ps5 (or any future PS-05 route) that prepares a ChatGPT-side image-generation handoff must call carousel_handoff.build_package()/write_package() (or read this file directly) rather than writing its own identity text -- this keeps the relay's durable route context and this project-level identity file from becoming two competing sources of truth. The route's own durable context (chatgpt-claude-bridge data/routes/ai-business-ps5/context.json) should record only a POINTER to this file (brand/nyx_identity/identity_spec.json), never a copy of the prose.
instructions_for_downstream_workers.chatgpt_side_image_generation: When the founder or a relay task asks ChatGPT directly to draw Nyx (outside carousel_handoff's own package flow), attach reference_hierarchy[0]'s image (upload the actual file at brand/nyx_identity/reference_primary.webp, or share reference_hierarchy[0].hosted_url) as the reference image, and prepend base_generation_prompt.identity_block to the request before the scene-specific SCENE/WARDROBE/POSE/CAMERA/LIGHTING/MOOD block.
instructions_for_downstream_workers.compliance_note_for_founder: Flagging, not deciding: the original stylized/non-photorealistic choice was partly a platform-compliance decision (Fanvue + Fansly both explicitly clear synthetic/stylized AI personas more easily; a photorealistic AI persona was assessed as narrowing platform options and drawing more moderation scrutiny, especially on Instagram/TikTok/Reddit acquisition content). Moving to photorealism is the founder's explicit, repeated instruction and has been applied as directed -- this note exists only so the tradeoff stays visible, not to second-guess it.
